og.title: Moderntech FAQ
og.description: Everything you need to know before ordering a laptop part — compatibility, warranty, delivery and payment.

page.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
page.intro: Can't find your answer here? Send us your laptop model or question directly on WhatsApp and we'll reply within minutes.

items.q: How do I know this part fits my laptop?
items.a: Each listing shows exact compatible models. If you're unsure of your laptop's exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

items.q: What if I order the wrong part by mistake?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp before the part ships and we'll swap it at no extra cost. Once a part has shipped, our standard returns policy applies.

items.q: Do you sell parts for older or discontinued laptop models?
items.a: In many cases yes — send us your model number on WhatsApp and we'll check current stock, even for models not yet listed on the site.

items.q: Are these genuine or compatible parts?
items.a: It's stated clearly on each product page — new OEM-equivalent by default, with genuine originals where available.

items.q: What warranty comes with these parts?
items.a: Most parts carry a 6-month warranty, listed on the individual product page. Warranty covers manufacturing defects, not physical damage.

items.q: What happens if a part fails within the warranty period?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp with your order details and a description of the fault. We'll arrange a replacement or repair depending on the part.
Same-day within Nairobi for orders confirmed before mid-afternoon. 1–2 days to major towns countrywide.
Yes, countrywide. Delivery cost and timing depend on your location — ask us on WhatsApp for an exact quote.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: M-Pesa is the most common, plus cash on delivery in Nairobi for orders confirmed on WhatsApp. We'll confirm the best option when you order.

items.q: Do you offer bulk or trade pricing?
items.a: Yes — repair shops and businesses ordering regularly get volume pricing, priority stock holds and credit terms. See our Technicians & Bulk Orders page or chat with us on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I hold stock before confirming an order?
items.a: For regular trade customers, yes. Ask us about priority stock holds when you set up a trade account.

technician_cta.heading: Repair Technician? Get Bulk Pricing.
technician_cta.body: Volume pricing, priority stock holds and credit terms for repair shops and businesses.

final_cta.heading: Still Not Sure?
final_cta.copy: Send us your laptop model or describe the problem on WhatsApp — we'll help you find the right part in minutes.
